utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Ms. Pack. Yes Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] For me it would be important to know what the provenance of this document is. Was this letter sent or was it found in my archives? Was it found with someone to whom it had been sent? I simply don't know where the Prosecution got this from.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We are about to hear from Ms. Pack about this.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: I can assist, Mr. President. It was a document that was on diskette which was part of the inventory of the red bag and its contents that were later identified as belonging to the accused and were recovered from the location of Majora Zorana Radosavljevica Street number 327 in Belgrade on the 11th of August, 2008. It was recovered at the time of the accused's arrest as a result of a phone call stating that a red bag could be found at this location. And in that bag was the diskette and on that diskette was this document. It was seized then by an investigator from this Tribunal, seized on the 20 -- 11th of August, 2008.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And now you're tendering that.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Yes, I should like to tender that, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: I should add -- I should add it's also on the accused's 65 ter list. So there's no question -- let me -- let me just check that.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: It's not necessary. We don't object to the document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. We'll receive it.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P6399, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I just want it to be clear for the Trial Chamber. I have a lot of texts that were never sent to anyone. They just remained as drafts, but I have no objections, really.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We are aware of that situation as well. It may go to the weight, but we'll see what weight will be given to this letter. Please proceed, Ms. Pack.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Now, I want to return to your statement, please. Paragraphs 21 and 22 talk about directive 7. You express at paragraph 22 your complete astonishment that the accused's signature is on this document, is on directive 7. Completely astonished.

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: [In English] Mm-hmm. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Can I ask you to look, please, at directive 7. That's P00838. I'd like you to look at a particular part of that document.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: That's at page 10 of the English, B/C/S page 15, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could I please have a look at the first page and the last page to see whether this is a document of the president of the republic?

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: I'm not going to show you these pages. This is an exhibit that is -- is going to take too long. This document has been admitted --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: No, no. Let's start. Let's show the first page as well.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Let's start with the first page, please. Page 1.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Supreme Command of the armed forces of Republika Srpska. That is not right. This should be the letterhead of the president of the republic and there should be a number, 01- -- yes?

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: I haven't asked you a question yet. You're being shown the first page --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And show him the page 23 or --

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: You're being shown the first page --

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: I thought you were asking me for my comment.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: No, I wasn't. I'm showing you the first page so you can see what this document is. It's the document to which you've referred in your witness statement, right? Directive 7. So this is the first page and you can confirm that this is the document about which you are speaking in your witness statement, and we can look at the last page, please?

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Just showing you the last page so that you can confirm -- this actually the -- the penultimate page will probably be the better page.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, not in Serbian.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: And -- and there you can see --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In English the first page.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: And in English the first page. Thank you very much, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: So you can see there what this document is. Satisfied that this is -- I'm showing you directive 7, yes?

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: Give me the last page so I see the signature.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: So the last page is -- is -- is the preceding -- is two pages back --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Page 21.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Thank you. That's the one.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Now, this is the last page of the directive, directive 7. Okay? I'm not asking you --

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: The signature --

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: -- for a comment at the moment. I'm just asking for you to confirm that this is the document about which you are speaking in your statement. Yes?

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's the document that I am speaking of, yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Can we move, please, back to page 10 of the English and page 15 of the B/C/S.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Now, I just want to ask you about -- in the B/C/S it's the paragraph midway through the page with the heading "Drina Corps." You see that?

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: You can see the bottom of the first paragraph there. I'm going to read out that sentence: "By planned and well thought-out combat operations, create an unbearable situation of total insecurity with no hope the further survival or life for the inhabitants of Srebrenica and Zepa."

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: Madam Prosecutor, you've missed the point altogether. In paragraphs 21 and 22 I said something different. I was not speaking at all about the content --

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Well, wait a second --

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: I was saying --

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Wait a second. What you say in paragraph 22, what you say is this contains sentences completely contrary to the accused's convictions so that you doubt he ever signed it. So I'm asking you about this sentence here, this sentence that you see. You see this sentence? And I'm asking you if you consider that this sentence is one of the sentences you were astonished by because what it says is so obviously repulsive and wrong.

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: This vocabulary is not the vocabulary of President Karadzic. These are some military terms that the president did not really use when writing, when he composed certain texts. These are military terms and this was written by someone from the army, yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: So you suggest that the accused was tricked into signing this document or he just didn't bother to read it? Is that the two hypotheses that you have?

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: Yes. These are the two hypotheses. This document was not written in accordance with the rules of the office of the President of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Stop a moment --

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: This document had to be -- yes?

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Are you seriously suggesting to this Court that the Supreme Commander of the armed forces signed a directive outlining the main priorities of the armed forces for the upcoming period, strategy, roles of the various corps, he signed it without bothering to read it? Is that what you're suggesting?

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: What I am suggesting is that perhaps he hadn't even signed this document. This signature looks like his signature, but I'm not sure that he's the one who signed this. I'm not sure that this is his signature.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: You're suggesting it's --

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: That it's his signature.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: You don't think it's his signature?

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: I'm actually even thinking along those lines. I'm wondering whether this is his signature at all because everything was done against the rules of our office. Just look at each and every document of our office. Just look at what documents written in the office were. Take, say, a document of mine that I worked on. Up there it says: The President of Republika Srpska. There should be a letterhead there and then there should be a register in the strictly confidential archives --

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: Stop a moment --

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: -- of the president of the Republika Srpska. This has not even been registered properly. It's not even in the register.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... let's get back to the signature.

utterances.speaker: GORDAN MILINIC
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MS. PACK
utterances.text: In this court one of the accused's former secretaries has testified that on this document appears the accused's signature. This is his signature. You deny that this is the accused's signature. Or what are you saying, that might be the case, you're not sure? What is your evidence?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Objection.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Overruled.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Answer the question and we'll adjourn for today.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, I wish to express my doubts in terms of this document, in terms of whether it was written in the office of the president of the republic. The president had a military office of his own with strictly set procedure. There has to be a sign there saying "strictly confidential." Yes?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Let's show page 21. Let's forget the formalities or whatever procedure there must have been. Do you think this is a signature of Mr. Karadzic or not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The signature looks like it, but I cannot guarantee fully that it is his, no. It's similar. It is similar.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. We'll adjourn for today and continue tomorrow at 9.00, but I'd like to advise you, Mr. Milinic, while -- in the meantime you're not supposed to discuss with anybody else about your testimony. Do you understand that, sir?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Quite. No problem whatsoever.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 12th day of June, 2013, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.48 p.m.,
